title: [GMCP 203.019.06] Operations and evidence: Human consent, approvals, and interaction UX
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-019-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Every consequential MCP action has a consistent inspect-before-run experience showing server identity, exact tool and arguments, data leaving the machine, credentials and side effects, with session and durable consent scoped separately. Approval is revocable, non-transferable and inaccessible to untrusted content; headless denial, accessibility, batching, timeout and emergency-stop behavior are all deterministic and audited. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
